Welcome to my technical blog! Here I share insights, tutorials, and thoughts about:

What You'll Find Here

  • AI & Machine Learning: Latest developments in LLMs, LangChain, and AI applications
  • Game Development: Unity, C#, and interactive experience development
  • Software Engineering: Best practices, architecture, and development workflows
  • Interactive Technologies: Hardware integration and immersive experiences

About Me

I'm Islam Talha, a Lead Software Developer at Somnia Solutions, working on interactive games with AI activations and hardware integrations for events. I have experience in game development, AI systems, and creating engaging user experiences.

Stay tuned for more technical content and insights!
